```{r}
lowerTriangle <- function(m){
  return(m[lower.tri(m)])
}

cosine_matrix = function(raw_data){
    # rel*rel matrix caculated by cosine similarity
    n <- nrow(raw_data)  # raw_data is an n x n matrix, 159*dimensions
    # create an empty matrix to store cosine similarity
    raw_data_cor <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
    colnames(raw_data_cor) <- rownames(raw_data)
    rownames(raw_data_cor) <- rownames(raw_data)
    # calculate the cosine similarity of the upper triangular part
    for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):n) {
            cosine_value <- cosine(as.numeric(raw_data[i, ]), as.numeric(raw_data[j, ]))
            raw_data_cor[i, j] <- cosine_value
        }
    }
    # symmetrically fill the cosine similarity in the lower triangular part
    raw_data_cor <- raw_data_cor + t(raw_data_cor)

    # set the diagonal to 1
    diag(raw_data_cor) <- 1
    return(raw_data_cor)
}
```

# linear regression
```{r}
compute_partial_R2 = function(model) {
    predictors = colnames(model)[-c(6)]
    results <- list()  
    lm.without <- update(model, ~. -Formality.human)
    results[['Formality']] <- partial.R2(lm.without, model)
    lm.without <- update(model, ~. -Activeness.human)
    results[['Activeness']] <- partial.R2(lm.without, model)    
    lm.without <- update(model, ~. -Valence.human)
    results[['Valence']] <- partial.R2(lm.without, model) 
    lm.without <- update(model, ~. -Exchange.human)
    results[['Exchange']] <- partial.R2(lm.without, model) 
    lm.without <- update(model, ~. -Equality.human)
    results[['Equality']] <- partial.R2(lm.without, model) 
    return(results) 
}
```

```{r}
pcsdv_114r_y = cbind(pcsdv_114r, bert_ancient_114r_array)
colnames(pcsdv_114r_y)[6] = 'Ancient.bert'

# 数据标准化
pcsdv_114r_y_scaled.a = data.frame(scale(pcsdv_114r_y))

# 运行线性回归模型
ancient_model = lm(Ancient.bert ~ Formality + Activeness + Valence + Exchange + Equality, 
                   data = pcsdv_114r_y_scaled.a)

summary(ancient_model)
#compute_partial_R2(ancient_model)
sum_ancient <- summary(ancient_model)
t_values_ancient <- sum_ancient$coefficients[-1, "t value"]

df_res_ancient <- sum_ancient$df[2]
ancient_partial_r2 <- (t_values_ancient^2) / ((t_values_ancient^2) + df_res_ancient)

print(ancient_partial_r2)
```

```{r}
# 提取古今模型的统计量
sum_ancient <- summary(ancient_model)
sum_modern <- summary(modern_model) # 确保你已经运行过 modern_model

# 提取t值和自由度
t_anc <- sum_ancient$coefficients[-1, "t value"]
df_anc <- sum_ancient$df[2]
t_mod <- sum_modern$coefficients[-1, "t value"]
df_mod <- sum_modern$df[2]

# 用精准数学公式计算偏R平方
partial_r2_ancient <- (t_anc^2) / ((t_anc^2) + df_anc)
partial_r2_modern <- (t_mod^2) / ((t_mod^2) + df_mod)

# 合并为纯净的数据框
partial_r <- rbind(ancient = partial_r2_ancient, modern = partial_r2_modern)

# 计算每行占各自行总和的比例
partial_r_prop <- sweep(partial_r, 1, rowSums(partial_r), "/")
partial_r_prop <- as.data.frame(partial_r_prop)

# 设定维度的顺序
dim_levels <- c('Formality', 'Activeness', 'Valence', 'Exchange', 'Equality')

# 生成宽数据 (用于画底层的灰色线段)
within_prop_segment <- data.frame(
  dim = factor(dim_levels, levels = dim_levels),
  ancient = as.numeric(partial_r_prop["ancient", ]),
  modern = as.numeric(partial_r_prop["modern", ])
)

# 生成长数据 (用于画表层的圆点)
partial_r_prop$epoch <- rownames(partial_r_prop)
within_prop_across <- melt(partial_r_prop, id.vars = 'epoch', variable.name = 'dim', value.name = 'prop')
within_prop_across$dim <- factor(within_prop_across$dim, levels = dim_levels)
within_prop_across$epoch <- factor(within_prop_across$epoch, levels = c('modern', 'ancient'))
```

```{r}
my.color <- c('modern' = "#a17db4", 'ancient' = "#9DCD82")

ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = within_prop_segment, 
               aes(x = dim, xend = dim, y = ancient, yend = modern),
               linewidth = 4.5, 
               color = "grey70", 
               alpha = 0.8) +    
  geom_point(data = within_prop_across,
             aes(x = dim, y = prop, fill = epoch),
             size = 7,           
             shape = 21,         
             color = "black",    
             stroke = 1.2) +     
  scale_fill_manual(values = my.color) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "black"), 
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = 'bottom',
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )
```
